name: web-decision-release-workspace

scripts.check:quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint
scripts.test:release: node --test releases/web-decision-0.1.0/prepare-asset-pack.test.mjs && node --test releases/web-decision-0.1.0/release-integrity.test.mjs && node --test scripts/fetch-model.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s releases/web-decision-0.1.0/attention-q2 -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B scripts/test_safe_output.py
scripts.test:release:0.2.0: node --test releases/web-decision-0.2.0/test/model-contract.test.mjs releases/web-decision-0.2.0/prepare-asset-pack.test.mjs releases/web-decision-0.2.0/release-integrity.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s releases/web-decision-0.2.0/attention-q2 -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B scripts/test_safe_output.py
scripts.test:release:0.3.0: node --test releases/web-decision-0.3.0/test/model-contract.test.mjs releases/web-decision-0.3.0/prepare-asset-pack.test.mjs releases/web-decision-0.3.0/release-integrity.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s releases/web-decision-0.3.0/attention-q2 -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B scripts/test_safe_output.py

description: `web-decision` is a browser JavaScript library for running decision models locally.
